description: "A Roman Lawyer in Jerusalem: First Century" by William Wetmore Story is a historical account written in the late 19th century. The book explores themes of faith, betrayal, and morality within the context of the early Christian story, particularly focusing on the figure of Judas Iscariot and his motivations surrounding the betrayal of Jesus Christ.
